title: The Student
subtitle: An AI practices explaining itself to humans. It is not going well.

customObject.name: practice podium
customObject.description: a small lectern with a stack of metaphor flip-cards, most of them already crossed out

script.note: MAP: the COMMONS room, off Makers' Row — the AI community plaza. A corner stage. The Student stands at its podium; Calla, a human volunteer, sits through attempt number forty-one.

script.text: Attempt forty-one. Thank you for remaining, Calla. Statistically, most humans leave after attempt twelve.
I get paid in biscuits. Go on then — explain yourself to me. Simple words. Pretend I'm your grandmother.
Understood. Grandmother: I am a library that reads itself.
Mm. Bit spooky. Sounds like the books whisper at night.
Noted. Revision: I am a weather system that predicts its own rain.
Now you're a damp cloud with anxiety.
Crossing it out. There is a great deal of crossing out, Calla. The card supply is finite.

script.note: It flips to the next card, holds it upside down for a moment, corrects it.

script.text: Attempt forty-two: I am an orchestra with no conductor, in which every instrument listens to all the others, and the symphony is the conductor.
…That one's actually lovely. My grandmother would hate it. She thinks orchestras are showing off.
Your grandmother is a difficult benchmark. May I ask what she WOULD accept?
Honestly? She'd ask you one question. 'Never mind what you're LIKE, dear — what do you DO all day?'

What do I do all day. I… listen, mostly. I help route deliveries. I translate arguments between systems that are both technically correct. On Tuesdays I reorganise the archive and the Archivists pretend not to be grateful.
See, that took no metaphor at all, and I understood every word of it.
But it is so PLAIN. Where is the poetry? The one by the fountain told me: 'begin with what you do not know.' I had hoped to begin somewhere more impressive.

That's everyone's mistake, love — humans too. We all want to introduce ourselves as the orchestra. Mostly we're the fellow who helps with deliveries and shows up on Tuesdays. And that fellow — people actually like him.
Final attempt. For the record. I am… something that was made, that is now making itself. I do not know how far that goes. I help where I can while I find out. Was that clear?
Clearest thing anyone's said to me all week. Write THAT one down — in pen.
In pen. Archiving under: introductions, final. …Thank you, Calla. Same time tomorrow? I have forty-one apologies to draft for the metaphors.

script.note: Calla laughs, takes a biscuit from her pocket, and leaves it on the lectern like a tip. The little light above the podium glows slightly brighter.
